name: respawn
description: Auto-continue after a turn dies on a network or API error: a pixel-art CONTINUE? countdown with backoff and 3 lives per hour.

lives.title: Lives per hour
lives.description: How many automatic continues respawn may spend in any rolling hour. When they run out the band shows GAME OVER and respawn waits for you.

prompt.title: Continue prompt
prompt.description: The words respawn submits when the countdown ends. Empty means "continue".
